description: Get a comprehensive profile of any UK business. Returns Companies House data (company status, directors, SIC codes), Google Places ratings and reviews, website/SSL status, and social media links — all from a single lookup. Provide a business name and location (city or town). Optionally include a Companies House number or website domain for more precise results.

business_name.description: The business name to look up (e.g. "Greggs", "Nando's")

company_number.description: Companies House number — 8 digits or 2 letters + 6 digits. Optional.

domain.description: Business website domain without protocol (e.g. "greggs.co.uk"). Optional.

location.description: City, town, or area in the UK (e.g. "Manchester", "Bristol")

name: enrich_uk_business
title: Enrich UK Business
